items.item_text: Teaching experience with veterinary students and/or house officers.

Responsible for the development, management, oversight of the Neurology/Neurosurgery Service at the UC Davis Veterinary Medical Center – Southern California (VMC-SC) in San Diego. Provides advanced diagnostic, medical, and surgical care for small animal patients with neurological diseases and disorders. Responsible for establishing and maintaining a high-quality specialty neurology service, collaborating with other specialty services, and ensuring excellence in patient care, client service, and referring veterinarian relationships.

In addition, provides mentorship, clinical instruction, and professional development opportunities for veterinary students, interns, residents, and clinical staff. Contributes to strategic planning, operational excellence, and the advancement of veterinary neurology and neurosurgery within the UC Davis VMC-SC.
